title: Digital Renaissance Editions
institution: University of Victoria (Digital Humanities / MoEML team)
notes:
Electronic scholarly editions of early English drama and related texts: late medieval moralities, Tudor interludes, occasional entertainments and civic pageants, academic and closet drama, and plays of the commercial London theatres. Editions are TEI-derived HTML. Not in the catalogue (REED English, DraCor and Théâtre Classique are listed, but not this collection).

Justification: A university-published collection of scholarly digital editions of early English drama squarely within the 1450-1700 window, with editorial apparatus. Found via a general web search for new digital edition projects; the site is live and stable.
Found at: https://digitalrenaissance.uvic.ca/
